page: Microsoft Azure F2alds_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine from the Faldsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical AMD EPYC 9V45 cores with an x86_64 architecture. Operating at a high base clock speed of 4.5 GHz, the processor includes 32 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16. The server is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

For storage, the instance is bundled with 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. In benchmark evaluations, the high-frequency AMD processor delivers top-tier single-core performance, scoring in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression. However, its multi-threaded capabilities are more constrained, with multi-threaded bzip3 decompression falling into the bottom 25% and stress-ng multi-core performance landing in the middle 50%.

Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read bandwidth is average at 428.85 GB/sec, the overall PassMark memory score is weak, placing in the bottom 25%. This resource density makes the F2alds_v7 a cost-efficient option for workloads that demand high single-threaded CPU speed but have low memory footprints. The hardware profile is best suited for lightweight single-threaded processing tasks, basic database operations, and small-scale web serving where local high-speed NVMe storage is beneficial but memory requirements remain minimal.

Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features a low-memory configuration of 4.0 GB RAM alongside 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The server delivers top-tier single-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for single-threaded stress-ng and compression benchmarks. However, its multi-threaded performance and memory bandwidth are average to weak, reflecting its resource-constrained profile. With no integrated GPUs, this server represents a cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring high clock speeds but minimal memory. It is best suited for single-threaded processing, lightweight database tasks, and basic web serving.
